text:
elaine: Heads-up — the batcher-drop-rate alert (prod) has been spiking every night ~02:00 for the last 3 days during the nightly embed job. It's noisy and drowning out real spikes. Can we discuss a short-term tuning or 1h mute?

sam: where do you want folks to look for graphs/traces? link?

elaine: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/BatcherOps/batcher-overview?orgId=1
Logs in Loki: https://loki.internal/explore?query=%7Bjob%3D%22batcher%22%7D
Traces in Tempo: https://tempo.internal/trace/ (search service=batcher -> look at span decode/emit)

jordan: thanks. can you paste the alert query? curious what threshold is.

elaine: alert rule is currently: `sum(rate(batcher_drops_total[5m])) / sum(rate(batcher_processed_total[5m])) > 0.05` (5% over 5m)
I propose either raising to 0.08 or adding a suppression window 01:45-03:30 for the embed pipeline for the next 72h while we dig in.

mike: +1 for temporary suppression while we triage. What's the business impact of those drops? Are requests failing or just retried?

elaine: mostly retries, client-side backoff covers it. RPS is higher during the batch job and queueing pushes the drop metric up. No customer-facing 5xxs observed.

sam: prefer changing alert severity from P1 -> P3 and bump threshold to 8% for now. That keeps visibility but reduces paging.

jordan: if we do suppression window, let's pin it to a schedule rather than full mute: use an alertmanager silence for `job=batcher AND env=prod AND pipeline=embed` for 1 hour windows each night until we fix. Easier to revoke.

mike: agree. Also will add a temporary annotation to the rule so oncall knows it's expected during embed runs: `expected_during: nightly_embed`

elaine: I'll create the silence and update the grafana/dashboard notes. Creating an incident ticket with details and steps to reproduce offline.

oncall-bot: New silence created by elaine for 1h (1976547000 - 1976550600) on labels: {job=batcher, env=prod, pipeline=embed}. ID: SLC-197654321.

sam: thanks. can someone follow up with a root cause doc once triage is done? quick checklist: capture KV cache hit-rate during job, batch size distribution, and worker scaling logs.

elaine: yes — I'll add that to the ticket and ping here when we have a RCA draft. :thumbsup:

mike: will also run a quick load replay against staging with the nightly job footprint and check batching heuristics.

jordan: ack. for the immediate action: elaine creates silence + annotation, sam lowers paging to P3, mike runs replay. We'll reconvene async here tomorrow.

elaine: done (silence created, rule annotated). I'll close this thread after RCA post.

sam: appreciated. :white_check_mark:
